limitations: Normal53100 and this final normal cohort are sequential, not ABBA; prompt/output/reuse conditions are reported separately. Prefix output bytes, generated counts and answer quality are recorded separately; a changed output is not a same-output speed comparison.

All selected weight precisions and Top2 decode remain unchanged; selected service/kernel changes retain their explicit provenance and numerical scope; finite task passes do not establish unchanged general model quality.
Host build refusals and failed attempts remain preserved in the private build artifacts; these do not represent PS5 launch attempts or physical impossibility.
No CI, learned host inference, reboot, forced reset, persistent shader cache or persistent pipeline cache was used.
